Question_text: A large volume of water has been contaminated with acid. Before the contaminated water can be disposed of, the acid must be neutralised by adding calcium carbonate. You are to determine by titration the concentration of hydrogen ions present in the contaminated water and then calculate the mass of calcium carbonate needed to neutralise all the acid.
Topic: 7.1 The characteristic properties of acids and bases
